Metadata.CommitMsg:
Flatten scanner/network/orchestrator services into the monorepo

These three apps were accidental embedded git repos (gitlinks, mode 160000)
with no .gitmodules, pointing at separate source remotes. The parent only
tracked the pointers, so their files could not be pushed via this repo and
clones got empty folders. Remove the nested .git dirs and commit the service
files as normal monorepo content, matching docs/adr/0008-consolidate-source-repos.md.
